R.q: Mrs. Lee has 43 pieces of candy to give out equally to 18 people. How many pieces does each person get?
choices: Round up to the next whole number
Split the remainder (write it as a decimal)
R.why: 43 ÷ 18 = 2 remainder 7. You cannot hand out part of a piece, so ignore the remainder: each person gets 2.
R.remember: Ask: what does the leftover mean here? If the extras cannot be used, ignore them. If everyone must be served, round up. If the leftover can be cut up, split it as a decimal.

R.remember: Ask: what does the leftover mean here? If the extras cannot be used, ignore them. If everyone must be served, round up. If the leftover can be cut up, split it as a decimal.
